verses.text: Then Bildad from Shuah answered:
"How long will you go on talking like this? Your words are like a strong wind.
Does God twist what is fair? Does the Almighty twist what is right?
When your children sinned against him, he gave them the punishment their sin deserved.
But if you will look to God and beg the Almighty for mercy,
if you are pure and honest, he will surely get up to help you and give you back your rightful home.
Even though you started with little, you will end up with much more.
Ask the people who lived before us. Find out what their ancestors learned.
We were only born yesterday and know nothing. Our days on earth are like a shadow.
Won't they teach you and tell you? Won't they share the wisdom of their hearts?
Can papyrus grow tall where there is no marsh? Can reeds grow without water?
While they are still green and not yet cut, they dry up faster than any other plant.
That is what happens to everyone who forgets God. The hope of godless people dies.
What they trust in breaks apart. Their confidence is as weak as a spider's web.
They lean on their web, but it gives way. They hold on to it, but it does not last.
They are like a well-watered plant in the sunshine, spreading its shoots over the garden.
Its roots wrap around a pile of rocks and grip the stones.
But when it is torn from its place, that place denies it and says, 'I never saw you.'
That is the end of its joy, and other plants spring up from the ground in its place.
Look, God does not reject a person with no fault, and he does not help evil people.
He will yet fill your mouth with laughter and your lips with shouts of joy.
Those who hate you will be covered with shame, and the homes of the wicked will be gone."
